description: Spec 016 research R9: the training mix of the learned whole-period model. Every engagement of the stream draws its family and its bearing-error overlay from its own sub-stream of the stream seed (tma2.regress.period_data). Families: 40% Annex B plus the 25% R9 leaves unassigned (0.65 in all), 20% randomised statistics, 15% quiet. Independently, a quarter of all engagements carry an overlay: correlated error, outliers or both, a third each. Bias and the unknown-sigma factor are never in training (the absent-from-training split). Each engagement is cut to a period as Gate T does (tma2.timelate.periods.cut).

scaled: target_manoeuvre_angle_abs_rad (min and max, one factor; max at most pi)
